projects.title: Herbica AI
projects.summary: An AI assistant for medicinal plant identification that explains properties, safety notes, and usage guidance from an image-first workflow.
projects.problem: Medicinal plant information is fragmented, hard to verify, and often inaccessible for everyday users.
projects.solution: A multimodal pipeline classifies plant images, retrieves structured herbal knowledge, and produces concise guidance with safety disclaimers.
results: Prototype target: 95% class accuracy on curated species

projects.title: AI Interview Practice Partner
projects.summary: A conversational mock interview system that adapts question difficulty, scores answers, and generates improvement roadmaps.
projects.problem: Interview preparation is often passive, generic, and disconnected from real-time feedback.
projects.solution: An AI interviewer conducts role-specific sessions, evaluates answers against rubrics, and recommends focused practice loops.

projects.title: TN Kalvi Hub
projects.summary: A learning hub for Tamil Nadu students with personalized study paths, bilingual explanations, and curriculum-aware AI support.
projects.problem: Students need affordable, localized, and curriculum-aligned support outside the classroom.
projects.solution: A GenAI learning layer produces Tamil and English explanations, quizzes, and revision paths matched to syllabus goals.

projects.title: Resume-JD Matcher
projects.summary: An ATS-style semantic matcher that compares resumes to job descriptions and explains gaps with improvement suggestions.
projects.problem: Candidates struggle to understand how their resume maps to a specific role beyond keyword matching.
projects.solution: A semantic matching engine scores fit, identifies missing skills, and produces targeted rewrite guidance.

researchPaper.title: Medicinal Plant Leaf Identification Using Transfer Learning and Deep Learning Techniques
researchPaper.abstract: This paper presents a transfer learning approach for automated medicinal plant leaf identification, combining deep convolutional neural networks with domain-specific feature extraction to achieve high-accuracy classification with limited training data. The system demonstrates practical deployment potential for healthcare, agriculture, and biodiversity research.
